resources.string: This profile only changes the local test bitmap. It does not calibrate the printer or send paper, density, or offset settings.
20–48 mm; 48 mm is about 384 dots at 203 dpi
Rotation changes the content inside the same physical paper canvas; it does not change the print-head width limit.
Offsets deliberately move and clip content at the paper edge. Check the preview before printing.
Enter width 20–48 mm, height 10–100 mm, and offsets within the shown ranges.
